scope: Bounded floorplan investigation, not an impossibility proof or exhaustive optimizer. Active candidate chosen only after separate locator-inclusive conservative geometry and electrical-locality review.
selection_notes: Earlier centered north/south and west/east candidates were rejected and remain unchanged in the historical study.
Offset south DATA at X3.8 preserves the MCU cluster. Motor header rotates and moves east; driver and its local bypass/sense group move north.
Final explicit local corrections add genuine USB locator-to-copper/body clearance, including pre-existing north-PD overlaps. These were verified after, rather than accepted from, the optimizer score.
The final full pose set is anchor-reference.json, the before/after list and origin-distance review are placement-review.json, and pin/net copper lower bounds are pad-locality-review.json.

Counterfactual geometry is rigidly transformed historical native geometry with matching transformed poses, not a new native build. Native acceptance, routing and assembly review remain parent-owned gates.

Final focused check physically rotates C_BULK180 degrees at unchanged XY. Selected for shorter positive feeds and more balanced driver connection, with longer ground return explicitly retained as a routing-review requirement.
After fresh native output, only TP_BOOT/TP_BOOT_GND/TP_3V3 were moved to eliminate actual test-pad/fitted-courtyard interference; reviewed electrical, USB and motor component poses remain unchanged.
